messages:
maria_devex: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for integration examples (Python + TS) for the next sprint. Customers keep asking for chat+tool-calling patterns and embeddings->rerank end-to-end. Can we itemize required examples and concrete launch criteria? @kevin_sdk @tara_docs

kevin_sdk: +1. My shortlist: 1) minimal chat usage (sync + streaming) 2) function/tool calling example (sync + async) 3) embeddings -> simple top-k rerank 4) structured-output example with JSON schema validation 5) deployment note (hosted vs private) + TS types + Python docstrings.

tara_docs: Add changelog entries & migration notes for any type changes. We also need runnable example repos (package.json, requirements.txt) and short README per example. ETA for draft examples: EOD Friday. :spiral_calendar:

simon_prod: For launch criteria, let's include: a) perf benchmark (90th percentile latency target) b) quality baseline using a small eval set (rerank MRR/precision) c) security sign-off for Private customers d) docs/editorial pass. Customers have asked for deterministic-ish rerank behavior — we'll state limitations.

lee_eng: From infra: streaming example should include a small local websocket runner and a Dockerfile for the example to be reproducible. We'll need to call out batch_size defaults and a note about KV cache for tool workflows. I'll drop a minimal Dockerfile snippet in the repo.

maria_devex: Proposed launch checklist: 1) runnable examples (PY + TS) that spin up in <5min 2) TS types and Python type stubs 3) changelog + migration guide 4) perf & quality checks (small eval harness included) 5) docs editorial + API surface callouts (differences for hosted/dedicated/private). Any objections? :thinking_face:

kevin_sdk: No objections. Also propose an extra example showing structured output + schema validation using ajv (TS) and jsonschema (PY) — helps customers with typed downstream processing.

tara_docs: Good call. I'll include a snippet in the docs and a minimal eval prompt set. Will ping for review once PRs are up.

ci-bot: deploy preview for docs available: https://deploy-ci.example.com/1745678901 — status: success with 2 warnings.

maria_devex: OK thanks. For prioritization: can we scope rerank to an MVP that uses embeddings + top-k + small scoring script? Full pipeline (indexing/backfill/streamed rerank) is follow-up. @simon_prod

simon_prod: MVP sounds fine. We'll communicate to the customer that full infra work is on the roadmap next quarter.

kevin_sdk: I'll open PRs for ts-examples, py-examples, types, and changelog now and tag @tara_docs for review. Expect first PRs in the next 24h.

maria_devex: Awesome — let's sync next week after the first PR review. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
